title: Lightweight AFK
description: Detects idle players and shows an [AFK] tag above their name.
body:
AstroSimpleAFK detects when players go idle and displays an [AFK] tag above their name. Reset on movement or chat. Configurable timeout, bypass permission, and broadcast options.

Features:
- Configurable AFK timeout
- [AFK] prefix above player name
- Optional broadcast when player goes AFK or returns
- Bypass permission for staff
- Reset triggers: movement, chat, command, interaction
- Works on Paper 1.20+

Commands:
- /afk - Toggle AFK manually
- /afk reload - Reload config

Permissions:
- astrosimpleafk.bypass - Skip auto-AFK detection
- astrosimpleafk.reload - Use reload command
